title: Hierarchical Server Architecture for Agentic Science
abstract: arXiv:2608.05332v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agentic science is transforming the landscape of computational work, and is applied to scientific pipelines and workload managers. Scientific workloads require specialized hardware within and between institutions. Automated resource discovery is an essential step for scheduling workloads with specific hardware and environmental requirements. In this paper, we present a hierarchical, dynamic architecture and accompanying software to discover resources across diverse cloud, edge, and HPC systems. The design enables concurrent, asynchronous negotiation, selection, and dispatch of requests for work using secretary agents. The agents probe and discover 51 real and simulated providers across 7 categories. We perform 19,973 negotiation and 6,952 selection simulations to assess reliability of decisions, demonstrating high (87.71%) negotiation accuracy and selection costs comparable to more traditional strategies. translated_title: 面向智能体科学的分层服务器架构
translated_abstract: 智能体科学正在改变计算工作的格局，并被应用于科学流水线和工作负载管理器中。科学工作负载需要在机构内部和机构之间使用专门的硬件。自动化资源发现是调度具有特定硬件和环境要求的工作负载的关键步骤。在本文中，我们提出了一种分层的动态架构及配套软件，用于发现跨多样化云、边缘和高性能计算（HPC）系统的资源。该设计通过秘书智能体实现工作请求的并发、异步协商、选择和分发。这些智能体探测并发现了7个类别中的51个真实和模拟的提供者。我们进行了19,973次协商和6,952次选择模拟来评估决策的可靠性，展示了较高的协商准确率（87.71%）以及与传统策略相当的选择成本。该设计具有可扩展性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种分层动态架构及配套软件，通过秘书智能体实现跨云、边缘和HPC系统的资源自动发现以及工作请求的并发异步协商、选择与分发，在近2万次模拟中实现了87.71%的协商准确率和与传统策略相当的选择成本。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a hierarchical, dynamic architecture and accompanying software that employs secretary agents for automated resource discovery across cloud, edge, and HPC systems, enabling concurrent and asynchronous negotiation, selection, and dispatch of work requests with 87.71% negotiation accuracy demonstrated through nearly 20,000 simulations.
